class.name: RailVehicleSpringBrake
class.brief_description: Class that handles all spring-brake-related operations
class.description: Spring brake is used to secure the vehicle after switching off. There is a spring in the cylinder that, due to the loss of air from the system, tightens so that the brake is still braked The spring brake is loosened by filling the cylinders with air

method.name: get_active
method.description: Whether the spring brake is switched on ([code]SpringBrake.Activate[/code]).

method.name: get_braking
method.description: Whether the spring actually brakes, from the cylinder pressure ([code]SpringBrake.IsActive[/code]).

method.name: get_ready
method.description: Whether the spring brake is ready to brake - the cylinder armed, the spring tensioned ([code]SpringBrake.IsReady[/code]).

method.name: get_shut_off
method.description: Whether the spring brake is shut off ([code]SpringBrake.ShuttOff[/code]).

method.name: spring_brake_activate
method.description: The spring brake switched on or off ([code]SpringBrakeActivate()[/code]).

method.name: spring_brake_shut_off
method.description: Closes ([code]true[/code]) or opens ([code]false[/code]) the spring brake's shut-off valve ([code]SpringBrakeShutOff()[/code], [code]Train.cpp:6859[/code]). A spring brake shut off is not charged and does not brake.
